test_item:
The software shall start the key installation process if the USB device/SDCard is inserted with the available key material present in the specified external storage directory.
(after reboot the installation status changes to INSTALLED (2))
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. A USB drive containing valid platform keys has been inserted into the HU USB port
3. The DUT has been power cycled after the key material was imported
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate
er: 1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate output shows the installstate value 2
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-007 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
source: Z1 IntegrationTests/PythonTests/common/keys_install_helper.py (installstate path and state values verbatim)
sibling axis: persistence after reboot; rule 5 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
